eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN ADMINISTRATIVE MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Arizona; at 3:49 PM on AUG 22, 2026 Effective until 11:49 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: This is the Arizona Department of Public Safety.  A SAFE Alert has been issued for Willcox Police Department. The Willcox Police Department is looking for 71 year old Danny Catano.  Danny is a white male, 5 feet 10 inches tall, 200 pounds and has dark brown hair with brown eyes.  He was last seen at 6:30 AM on 8/22/26 on foot wearing blue jeans, a floral shirt, white jacket and tennis shoes near the 900 block of West Rex Allen Drive in Willcox, Arizona.  Danny has a medical condition which may cause him to become lost or easily confused.  If you have seen Danny, please contact the Willcox Police Department at 520-254-1132 or call 911. If you have contact with this SAFE Alert, please call 911. Monitor TV and Radio for updates.
